0022600143.text: The Lakers (3-1) head into their fifth game of the season, sitting first in the Pacific and fifth in the West after a loss in their last outing, while the Clippers (1-2) are ninth in the West, 1.5 games behind them in the Pacific, and on a two-game losing streak. Out for the Lakers are Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back) and Ziaire Williams (foot), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning the last meeting 125-117 in Los Angeles, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
